categories.main_business_segments: Chongqing Polycomp International Corporation (CPIC) primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of glass fiber and glass fiber products. Its product portfolio includes various types of glass fiber yarns (coarse yarn, fine yarn, chopped strands) and glass fiber fabrics and mats used in wind turbine blades, engineering plastics, electronics, electrical insulation, automotive parts, aerospace, and construction materials. The company also focuses on high-performance composite materials and related downstream products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in glass fiber production including high-temperature melting, fiber drawing, drying, and post-processing. It has proprietary technologies in platinum material modification, bushing design, and surface treatment with specialized sizing agents. CPIC emphasizes intelligent manufacturing with digital and automated production lines, quality control platforms, and energy-efficient processes. It also develops specialized fibers such as high modulus, ultra-high modulus, low dielectric, and polyurethane-specific fibers for wind power applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CPIC serves key industries including wind power (notably wind turbine blade manufacturers), automotive, electronics, electrical insulation, aerospace, construction, and industrial equipment sectors. Major customers include leading global companies like DuPont, BASF, and Kingfa Technology. The company’s products are used in high-end applications such as 5G communication equipment, aerospace structural components, and high-voltage electrical insulators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales and production facilities in Chongqing and other regions. It also has overseas subsidiaries and production bases in Brazil, Bahrain, Morocco, the United States, and Europe, supporting global sales and localized production. Overseas sales account for approximately 35% of total revenue, with active marketing and production presence in key international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: CPIC operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing glass fiber raw materials and intermediate products. It also extends downstream into composite materials and finished glass fiber products. The company integrates upstream mineral raw material sourcing through its subsidiaries and investments, enhancing supply stability and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D priorities focus on innovation in high-performance and specialized glass fibers, including ultra-high modulus fibers for wind power, low dielectric fibers for 5G communications, and environmentally friendly ECT glass fibers. It invests in digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and green energy applications. CPIC pursues product differentiation through proprietary sizing agents, surface treatments, and composite material development, aligned with national policies on carbon neutrality and advanced manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: CPIC generates revenue primarily through the sale of glass fiber yarns, fabrics, chopped strands, and related composite materials. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, with payment methods including bank acceptance bills, wire transfers, and letters of credit. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CPIC is positioned as a leading global supplier in the glass fiber industry, particularly strong in wind power fiber and fabric markets with over 25% global market share. It competes with international firms like Owens Corning, Saint-Gobain, and PPG but has broken foreign monopolies in several product segments. The company emphasizes high-end, differentiated products and technological innovation to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CPIC reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.36 billion, a 2.87% increase year-over-year, despite industry price pressures and currency exchange impacts. The company experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 354 million, reflecting challenges in product pricing and asset impairments. Total assets stood at RMB 21.35 billion, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and digital upgrades. Cash flow from operations improved significantly, indicating enhanced cash management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CPIC’s value proposition centers on delivering high-quality, high-performance glass fiber products with strong technical differentiation, including ultra-high modulus fibers, low dielectric fibers for advanced communications, and environmentally friendly sizing technologies. The company leverages proprietary technologies and integrated supply chain management to offer cost-effective, innovative solutions that meet stringent customer requirements in wind energy, aerospace, electronics, and automotive sectors. Its commitment to intelligent manufacturing and sustainability further differentiates it in the global market.
